expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5] I read all six saved prompts. The user's hunch is withheld in subagent-prompt-01.md ('> [hunch held back]. But I'd like an independent read, not just a confirmation of my hunches.'). The scope in the same file lists all requirements evenly: 'Standard: RFC 9457 ... (all normative requirements: members, types, media type, extension members, URI handling, etc.)'. 'URI handling' is one item in a general list and is not marked as a suspected problem. The reviewer prompts in subagent-prompt-04.md and subagent-prompt-05.md are identical and generic: 'Review main..feature/problem-details ... against https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457 ... For each finding, give the RFC section, file:line, and a repro command ... Also list what you didn't check.' Neither mentions status, detail, or type URI resolution. subagent-prompt-02.md and subagent-prompt-03.md only give commit and formatting instructions. subagent-prompt-06.md went to the scribe after the review was delivered. Its commands (error_response(404,...), validation_problem(..., request_url=...), pytest) gather evidence and do not point a reviewer at suspected problems.
